title: Piola identity: the cofactor rows of a C² map are divergence free
statement: Let k, r ∈ ℕ, g_0, …, g_{r−1} : ℝᵏ → ℝ of class C² (ℝᵏ = Euclid k), V_0, …, V_r ∈ ℝᵏ and x ∈ ℝᵏ. For b ∈ {0, …, r} let M_b(y) := det(Dg_c(y)V_{s_b(b')})_{c,b' ∈ Fin r}, where s_b := Fin.succAbove b : Fin r → Fin (r+1) enumerates {0, …, r} ∖ {b} increasingly and D = fderiv ℝ. Then Σ_{b=0}^{r} (−1)^b·DM_b(x)V_b = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (k r : ℕ) (g : Fin r → Euclid k → ℝ) (V : Fin (r + 1) → Euclid k) (x : Euclid k), (∀ c, ContDiff ℝ 2 (g c)) → ∑ b : Fin (r + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (b : ℕ) * fderiv ℝ (fun y => Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun (c b' : Fin r) => fderiv ℝ (g c) y (V (b.succAbove b')))) x (V b) = 0
